text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a national-scale spatial land system modeling study for Turkey, explicitly simulating future land use/land cover (LULC) changes to 2050 under two scenarios—business-as-usual and a Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) scenario—with quantitative comparison of outcomes. The primary objective is to assess how LDN implementation alters future land system patterns, making LULC prediction central to the research question. The CLUMondo model allocates spatially explicit land system changes at 2 km resolution across the entire country, producing mapped projections (e.g., Fig. 4). The study reports quantitative metrics such as area extents of land degradation/improvement, conversion causes, and regional breakdowns by biogeographical zones. It satisfies all core inclusion criteria: national-scale implementation, primary focus on LULC simulation, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with quantified outputs, and mapped LULC projections. It does not meet any exclusion criteria.)
